name: tuilens
description: Terminal automation for AI agents with PTY sessions, image-aware capture, visual testing, performance regression baselines and MCP.

scripts.check: node scripts/sync-version.mjs --check && node scripts/check-dependency-policy.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.format: biome format --write src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome check --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.test: node scripts/sync-version.mjs --check && npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/sync-version.mjs --check && npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="dist/src/**" --test-coverage-lines=70 --test-coverage-branches=65 --test-coverage-functions=70 dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run format:check
